exposure: Women who walked or jogged ≥200 min/week vs Women who did not exercise
walking or jogging ≥200 min/week during pregnancy
outcome: Success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 1080 women who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean delivery between January 2018 and December 2019 in Foshan, China
finding: Walking or jogging ≥200 min/week during pregnancy significantly reduces the risk of cesarean delivery among women who undergo a trial of labor after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Walking or jogging at least 200 minutes per week during pregnancy significantly reduces the risk of cesarean delivery among women attempting vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
